definitions.explanation: A small shop or stall, typically in a station or public building.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{売店|ばいてん}で{新聞|しんぶん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a newspaper at the station kiosk.

examples.japanese: {売店|ばいてん}は{何時|なんじ}まで{開|あ}いていますか。
examples.english: Until what time is the shop open?

examples.japanese: {売店|ばいてん}で{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a drink at the kiosk.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}の{売店|ばいてん}で{雑誌|ざっし}や{お菓子|おかし}を{買|か}うことができる。
examples.english: You can buy magazines and snacks at the hospital shop.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{売店|ばいてん}は{昼休|ひるやす}みにとても{混|こ}んでいるので、{朝|あさ}{買|か}っておく。
examples.english: The school kiosk is very crowded at lunch, so I buy things in the morning.

notes: Often found in stations, hospitals, and schools.
